manual.note: Honda 2019 CR-V Owner's Manual (PDF, 672 pp; footer 19 CR-V ELP HCM MAP HMIN-31TLA6210). Oil and tires p.649, viscosity p.570, towing p.451, TPMS p.516. No battery capacity is printed. Printed page = PDF page - 2.

oilCapacity.value: 1.5L turbo (L15B): 3.7 US qt (3.5 L) with filter, 3.4 US qt (3.2 L) without; 2.4L (K24W): 4.7 US qt (4.4 L) with filter, 4.4 US qt (4.2 L) without
oilCapacity.appliesTo: Two engines were offered: 1.5L turbo on most trims and 2.4L on the LX. 2WD and AWD share the same fill.

oilViscosity.value: Genuine Honda Motor Oil 0W-20 or API Premium-grade 0W-20 detergent oil

batteryGroup.note: this edition prints no battery reserve-capacity or BCI group number

tpmsReset.value: Press and hold the TPMS button until the low tire pressure/TPMS indicator blinks twice; calibration then finishes automatically after about 30 minutes of cumulative driving at 30-65 mph. With the driver information interface or Display Audio, use Vehicle Settings > TPMS Calibration > Calibrate.

tires.note: Compact spare: T155/90D17 112M at 60 psi. Cold pressures differ front/rear.
